name_en: Nara-ae — simmered vegetables tossed with chopped narazuke pickles
summary_ja: 刻んだ奈良漬をぜんまいやかんぴょう、薄揚げの煮ものに加えて和える奈良の家庭料理。冷めて味がなじんだ頃に食べるとされ、奈良漬が苦手な子どもにも好まれる一皿として給食にも取り入れられている。
summary_en: A Nara home dish that folds chopped narazuke pickles into a simmer of osmund fern, dried gourd shavings, and fried tofu. It is said to taste best once cooled and settled, and is served in school lunches as a dish even children who dislike narazuke on its own tend to enjoy.
source_publisher: 農林水産省「うちの郷土料理」
